Chapter 7199: Perfect Creation

Chapter 7199: Perfect Creation

Although she suppressed Li Qiye, she didn’t injure him. Her powers consisted of gentleness and love, merely preventing him from moving.

“The limits do not begin in the past or the present, you have crossed the line, understand?” He smiled.

The figure froze momentarily upon hearing this.

“Go back, you belong to the future, not the present, don’t cross the boundary again.” Having said that, he gently brushed her forehead, leaving behind a line.

“Clank!” An imprint resembling a signature finished the process, culminating in true perfection.

Echoing time waves could be heard for she did not belong here. Once the imprint was finalized, she had to return to the future where she belonged.

“Buzz.” Temporal rivers combined and formed a maelstrom. Before entering the maelstrom, she stared luminously at Li Qiye.

“That’s the future, it belongs to the living beings, you too.” Li Qiye smiled.

“Buzz.” The maelstrom and the figure disappeared instantly.

Worlds returned to their initial locations as if nothing had happened. Others didn’t expect Li Qiye to repel the unknown powers with something akin to signing.

Phoenix Queen and the others admitted that she was potentially stronger than the high heaven and Li Qiye.

“What were those powers?” Phoenix Queen murmured.

“Born from goodness and beauties with my permission.” Li Qiye smiled.

Everyone exchanged glances after hearing this.

“What was that thing?” Genesis asked.

“Didn’t you visit the future?” Li Qiye asked.

“Present didn’t permit me to enter.” Genesis said.

“Then you were an unsuccessful spy. This is in the name of love with the conscience of heaven and earth, the world belongs to living beings.” Li Qiye said.

The group murmured.

“Where is cultivation in this?” Octopus spoke in the ancient language.

“Only determination and love will grant long life.” Li Qiye said.

“They are not our world’s powers.” Heavenfall rebuked.

“Of course, immortals want to reign this world, the high heaven wants to be above all.” Li Qiye said.

“It is determined, karma is now written by you.” Phoenix Queen sighed.

“Yes, it has been written, right here and now.” Li Qiye said.

“I do not accept!” Heavenfall shouted.

“Can you shatter karma?” Li Qiye asked.

“My fate is mine!” Heavenfall said.

“Mine!” Octopus rushed toward Li Qiye.

“This is the karma that you have sown.” Li Qiye said before stopping time and becoming radiant.

Both Heavenfall and Octopus became crushed by his absolute power, being reduced to worldly essences.

Genesis and Phoenix Queen turned pale upon seeing this.

“I accept defeat.” Genesis took out the cloud from Heavencrush and said: “Sir, can you spare me?”

“Unfortunately, this is your karma.” Li Qiye shook his head.

“I see. Fine, I only regret being born in this world and not the future.” Genesis said.

“The future will not have you.” Li Qiye smiled.

“Neither will the present.” Genesis smiled bitterly before crushing himself.

“Ahh!” He decisively imploded and turned himself into worldly essences.

“Your turn.” Li Qiye told Phoenix Queen.

“I suppose it is time.” She sighed in response.

“Blink!” Suddenly, a muddled pair of eyes became lucid again, forming a terrible storm.

“Pop!” An old man surged out of thin air and appeared before Li Qiye and Phoenix Queen.

“Skykiller... you’re still alive?” Phoenix Queen trembled as she touched his face.

Although he had aged rapidly, he was still the man she loved the most. A fiery current flowed in his eyes from the future, hot yet gentle.

“Love woke him up, this is a power from the future.” Li Qiye sighed: “It’s just temporary.”

“That’s just fine.” She hugged him tightly while weeping: “I was wrong... I was wrong...”

After the heartfelt apology, she gazed directly into his eyes.

“Poof!” The flame in his eyes enveloped her, refining her into worldly essences.

“Goodbye, Skykiller.” She said with her last breath, disappearing from existence.

His flame extinguished and his corpse returned to its original place for a true death.
